roles.result.json: numbers for the panel: model 1 summary, model 2 forecast with interval, reliability notes
roles.cells.json: cells with model 1 score, recovery now, height, ndvi; GEDI posts (compact, for code)
roles.cells.geojson: the same cells as square polygons in lon/lat: add as a fill layer on a map
roles.gedi.geojson: measured GEDI canopy heights (rh98, m) as points
roles.rgb.png: Sentinel-2 true-colour picture; place by result.image.corners_lonlat
